Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAsh:
This area is covered in volcanic ash, huff-puff!
I'm specially gifted, huff-puff.
I make glass out of volcanic ash and make items, huff-puff.
Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootS:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk through piles of ash, huff-puff.
And it will fill up with the volcanic ash, huff-puff.
Once you think you've collected a good amount, come see me, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeColle: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff? Let me see, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh:
Hmmm… There's not enough ash here, huff-puff. I can't make glass with this, huff-puff.
Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps you'll need to walk for me to make you a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassIt:
Oh! You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!
I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff! Which one would you like, huff-puff?
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheIte: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? Is that the one for you, huff-puff?
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYo: Which one would you like, huff-puff?
